items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: We backed Wynonie Harris, the Blues singer, on his first big hit, "Around The Clock." ... And that was his first big hit, and I had a solo on that record.

ctx.x: No, that didn't happen while I was in the band -- that I knew of, you know; I don't know.

But during this period, we also made a very big record for the same company. In fact, we had their first hit. We backed Wynonie Harris, the Blues singer, on his first big hit, "Around The Clock." Remember "Around The Clock?" where it talked about when the clock struck one what happened, when it struck two -- he goes all the way through to 12 o'clock, you know, talking about what happened when the clock struck these different hours. And that was his first big hit, and I had a solo on that record.
Did you play that around town a lot?
